title: Affine change-of-variables bound for each t-slice over the unit ball
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, B := B̆_1(0) ⊂ ℝⁿ (ℝⁿ = Euclid n) the open unit ball, g : ℝⁿ → [0, ∞] measurable, and t ∈ [0, 1]. Then ∫_B ∫_B g((1 − t)y + tx) dy dx ≤ 2ⁿ·Lⁿ(B)·∫_B g. These are lower Lebesgue integrals in [0, ∞]; the outer variable is x and the inner variable is y.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (g : Euclid n → ℝ≥0∞), Measurable g → ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∫⁻ x in ball (0 : Euclid n) 1, ∫⁻ y in ball (0 : Euclid n) 1, g ((1 - t) • y + t • x) ≤ 2 ^ n * volume (ball (0 : Euclid n) 1) * ∫⁻ z in ball (0 : Euclid n) 1, g z
